SELECT CUST_MST.SANAME SANAME ,CUST_MST.CUSTNAME CUSTNAME ,MC20_MST.CUSTCD CUSTCD ,MC20_MST.JPNO JPNO ,MC20_MST.CDATE CDATE ,MC20_MST.AMT AMT ,MC20_MST.BANPUM BANPUM ,MC20_MST.TOTAMT TOTAMT ,MC20_MST.CASH CASHAMT ,MC20_MST.SALE SALEAMT ,0 MISUAMT ,MC20_MST.REMK REMK ,get_date_fmt(MC20_MST.PRDATETIME) PRDATE FROM MC20_MST , CUST_MST WHERE MC20_MST.CUSTCD = CUST_MST.CUSTCD AND MC20_MST.CHK = 'Y' AND MC20_MST.GROUPCD = #{USER.GROUPCD} AND MC20_MST.COMCD = #{USER.COMCD} AND MC20_MST.CDATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#{FRDATE},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{TODATE},'-','')
